messages:
Tess: quick sync — postmortem follow-ups from last night's GPU surge. I want a tight ownership list and delivery dates so this doesn't recur.
Omar: agreed. main patterns were quota exhaustion + aggressive downscale during tail traffic.
Chen: I can own scheduler tuning items. will propose params by EOD.
Priya: I'll take quota backstop and reserved headroom work. planning a PR for quota guard next week.
Lina: I'll do the hotspot detection rules and replay the traces for recurring spike patterns.
Tess: thanks. ops-bot do you have the timeline for last night events?
ops-bot: incident timeline available: https://redwood.internal/incidents/2765439876/timeline — surge started 02:17 UTC, first OOM 02:21, autoscale attempts 02:22-02:30, apparent rollback 02:32.
Omar: initial low-effort mitigations: bump `minAvailableGPUs` to 10 in the staging scheduler for a 24h trial. will instrument.
Chen: thinking of params: `scaleDownDelay=300s`, `burstThreshold=0.65`, and `graceWindow=120s`. putting draft in #eng-platform.
Priya: quota backstop design: add emergency reserved pool (10% of commit) + soft limits per-customer. draft ops playbook: 2026-03-30.
Lina: recurring pattern notes: spikes align with nightly batch eval jobs from a small set of customers (3 tenants). will ping solutions to stagger windows.
Tess: concrete action list (short):
- Chen: scheduler tuning PR (`scaleDownDelay`, `burstThreshold`) -> due 2026-03-25
- Priya: quota backstop RFC + playbook -> due 2026-03-30
- Omar: staging run with `minAvailableGPUs=10` and telemetry -> start 2026-03-24, run 48h
- Lina: tenant replay + stagger proposals -> due 2026-03-26
- Tess: coordinate canary & runbook updates -> due 2026-03-28
Omar: marking owners in tracker: https://redwood.internal/tasks/INC-2765439876/actions
Chen: quick config snippet I'll try in staging:
```yaml
scheduler:
  scaleDownDelay: 300  # seconds
  burstThreshold: 0.65
  graceWindow: 120
  minAvailableGPUs: 10
```
Priya: will also add automated alert that fires when available GPUs drop below commit - 12% for >5m. immediate alert to oncall + paging policy.
Lina: found two tenants running heavy eval at 02:10 UTC consistently. looping in @solutions for stagger.
Tess: decision: do both quota backstop + scheduler tuning. immediate staging bump as stopgap. long-term: quota policy + tenant scheduling.
Priya: question — do we want auto-warm of spare GPUs when utilization trends up? could pre-warm KV caches.
Omar: yes, propose warm-up lambda that triggers at 0.6 util sustained for 3m. add as follow-up.
Chen: will include metrics to measure regression: p95 latency, token cost delta, and scale events/sec.
Tess: weekly check-ins: add a recurring 30-min slot on Fridays for 4 weeks to validate.
Lina: scheduling note: I'll push tenant change requests tomorrow and log responses in tracker.
Priya: we'll draft runbook snippets for next oncall rotation.
Tess: final ask — everyone add final PR/patch link in the action tracker by their due date. I'll close the loop after the first Friday checkpoint. :thumbsup:
